title: Kiln natives a mod's Impact programs call (impact/natives.json), format 1
description: Declares the mod's Kiln natives ("<modid>.<Name>") for tools/impact (the cook's argc check) and kiln.abilities (the verifier). Read with Python's json module (tools/impact/impact/catalog.py): plain JSON, no comments, no trailing commas. Docs: docs/kiln/services/abilities.md#impact-program-and-native-contract-runtime-side, docs/kiln/modding/impact.md.

name.x-kiln-message: a Kiln native name is '<modid>.<Name>' with Name [A-Za-z0-9_]

hash.description: FNV-1a-32 over the full UTF-8 name (computed when omitted).

node.description: Vanilla natives only: the node name the hash is taken of.

argc.description: Values the ECALL pops (default: the length of args).

suspends.description: true for managed (C#) natives: the ECALL re-runs next step and then pushes the handler's value.

args.description: In args[] index order: args[0] is the LAST value pushed before the ECALL.

raw.description: Accepts a raw integer (not only a variable handle).

items.x-kiln-unknownKeysMessage: unknown key in a native (kept as extra data)
